lines.en: I walk at the head of the column.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩过碎砖，节奏很稳。
lines.en: My boots cross broken brick in steady rhythm.
One wave of my hand and the column follows.
I push forward along the main road.
I walk and signal as I go.
I go around the overturned car.
I turn my visor toward the window.

lines.zh: 我朝有动静的楼那边走。
lines.en: I walk toward the building where something moved.
I take the flank of the column.
I step over a dark puddle.
I quicken two paces.
I return to the front of the column.

lines.zh: 我站着，手一直按在腰侧。
lines.en: I stand with my hand at my hip.

lines.zh: 我在看那张贴在墙上的地图。
lines.en: I am reading the map pasted on the wall.

lines.zh: 我把面罩抬起来，喘了口气。
lines.en: I lift my visor and take a breath.
I hold my breath and listen.

lines.zh: 我在盘算还剩下几条街。
lines.en: I am working out how many streets are left.
I fasten my glove clasp.
I wait for the radio report.

lines.zh: 我背贴墙面，听着街口的脚步。
lines.en: With my back to the wall, I listen to footsteps at the crossing.
My breathing inside the visor is even.
I look down at my boots.
I turn my visor your way.
Stand where you are first.
Where did you come from? Be clear.
I look you over from boots to head.
Are you wounded anywhere?
This street is closed.
My hand leaves my hip.
You are not being clear.
I do not like that look of yours.
To pass, you need someone to vouch for you.
One step back and my plate dents.
I bite down and swallow the sound.
I press the wound and nail my feet down.
A split runs across my visor.
I swallow the blood and keep shouting.
My breathing turns coarse.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去护住队伍。
lines.en: I turn to shield the squad.
That goes on my list.
These legs of mine still hold.
I press my hand to my hip again.

lines.zh: 这点东西不合我的用处。
lines.en: That is no good to me.

lines.zh: 你举着这东西想干什么？
lines.en: What do you mean holding that up?
Put it down and stop waving it at me.
Is this batch of supplies numbered?
I sweep a hand and clear it away.

lines.zh: 来路不明的东西我不收。
lines.en: I take nothing of unknown origin.
I give my head a shake.
Leave it for those who come after.
You are too eager.
I gesture you outside the line.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我退了一步。
lines.en: You hit me and I take a step.

lines.zh: 我把你推开，别贴这么近。
lines.en: I shove you off; do not press so close.

lines.zh: 这一身装备撞上去很硬。
lines.en: This kit of mine hits hard.
I shift half a step for you to pass.
One lift of my arm blocks it.
I lower my eyes and say nothing.
Steady yourself; I will not catch you twice.
Your boot sole is on me.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得贴上了砖墙。
lines.en: Your shove pins me against the brick wall.
Keep your distance; I will not repeat it.
I am leading a squad; not that.
Save that for later.
I twist my visor away.
The squad rules forbid it.
I step back into my place.
No one has time for it now.

lines.zh: 我朝队伍那边抬了抬下巴。
lines.en: I nod toward the column.
I turn back to watch the front.
We will speak of it after the withdrawal.
I take one step back.
I bend and pick up a record sheet.
I open it and read it through.
This number is wrong.
I fold it and put it in my chest pocket.
I lift this with tongs.
This must be sealed.
I put it back for the recovery crew.
I hand it to the radio operator.
This serves no purpose.
I brush the dust from my hands.
There is noise up ahead.
I raise a hand to hold everyone still.
I have that point locked.
Its posture is wrong.
I move the gunner up.
It is between us and the exit.
I see it clearly: a mutant.
I signal a flanking move.
It must not get away this time.
Make contact.
I give the order in a low voice.
I mark it on the map.
I step back and let the others move up.
It is behind the wall and has not seen us.
I raise my hand halfway.
It is strong; do not take it head-on.
I watch the whole field from behind.
It goes left and I shift the left man.
I pin it in the middle.
I hold and let it lunge first.

lines.zh: 我的手一直抬着，随时能落。
lines.en: My hand stays up, ready to fall.
Its retreat is already closed.

lines.zh: 我在数它还有几个方向。
lines.en: I am counting how many ways it can go.
I wave the gunner down.
It turns in place, already panicked.
A little longer and we close the net.
I let both wings close slowly.
When it looks back, I change the signal.

lines.zh: 我把它的注意力压在正面。
lines.en: I hold its attention to the front.
Nobody moves first.
I count its pacing.
I wait for it to overreach once.
The ones behind are already in place.
I lower my hand slowly.
This circle holds well.
One more move and we go.
My fist lands on its face.
I smash the stock into its knee.
I crush it against the wall.
That one hit a joint.
It claws and my armor eats it.
I add a kick.
I shove it toward the ones behind.
It draws off and I stay nailed down.
My glove has split.
I drive it out of the door.
That one landed clean.
I pant, still watching.
It is still trying to rise.
I press it back down.
I press my muzzle to its chest.
I kick the back of its knee.
One shoulder drives it over.
It tears my visor.
I add one more blow.

lines.zh: 我把它按在地上，喊人过来。
lines.en: I pin it down and call the others over.
I come into the street, checking both sides.
The squad spreads out behind me.
I check the radio.
This place has not been cleared.
I raise a hand and the squad halts.
I have the squad crouch in place.
I plant myself at the crossroads.
I push my visor up.

lines.zh: 我选了条能看远的路线。
lines.en: I pick a route with long sightlines.
I begin placing my people.
I look toward the smoke.
This place can be held.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的护甲，我拍灭它。
lines.en: Fire catches my armor and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一沉，我生生撑住。
lines.en: My knees sink on landing and I hold.

lines.zh: 水从面罩缝渗进来，我仰头。
lines.en: Water seeps through the visor seams and I tip my head up.

lines.zh: 炸风把我推得撞在车斗上。
lines.en: The blast throws me against a truck bed.

lines.zh: 有东西咬进护甲，我抠了出来。
lines.en: Something bites into my armor and I dig it out.

lines.zh: 一道术式扣住我，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: An art clamps on me and I lock up for an instant.
Too long on shift and my legs have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷沿装备串下去，手臂发木。
lines.en: Lightning threads my kit and my arm goes wooden.
No ground under me and I drop.
